token = login_resp['access_token']

# Build keep/remove sets for albums
liked_album_ids = {a['album_id'] for a in liked_albums}
downloaded_song_ids = {s['song_id'] for s in downloaded_songs}
album_library_ids = {a['album_id'] for a in albums_in_library}

keep_album_ids = set()
for a in albums_in_library:
    aid = a['album_id']
    song_ids = a.get('song_ids') or []
    all_downloaded = all(sid in downloaded_song_ids for sid in song_ids)
    if aid in liked_album_ids or all_downloaded:
        keep_album_ids.add(aid)

remove_album_ids = sorted(album_library_ids - keep_album_ids)
print('liked_album_ids', len(liked_album_ids))
print('album_library total', len(album_library_ids))
print('keep albums', len(keep_album_ids))
print('remove albums', len(remove_album_ids))
print('remove_album_ids', remove_album_ids)
